title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13098v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. translated_title: VETR：面向符号图形推理的基于执行的自我改进智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13098v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于符号图形推理的视觉智能体依赖于可执行的世界表示，然而其持续改进仍受限于来自最终渲染结果的模糊监督。近期的智能体系统通过反复交互来优化场景，但它们缺乏从执行轨迹中递归提取可操作证据的机制，忽视了哪些被提出的符号编辑在程序执行过程中得以保留、消失或产生了干扰。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VETR（用于优化的经验证执行轨迹，Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement），这是一个使智能体能够在符号图形推理的可执行世界表示上进行递归自我改进的框架。在每个任务中，VETR保留与有限运行时观测对齐的程序/渲染记录，并引入一个执行优化器，将观测到的写入操作和状态变化编译为受约束的备选程序。该优化器根据验证条件对其终点和保留情况进行校验
tldr: VETR提出了一种以执行轨迹为依据的自我改进智能体框架，通过追踪程序执行中符号编辑的保留、消失与干扰情况，将执行证据转化为受约束的备选程序，从而实现符号图形推理的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: VETR introduces an execution-grounded self-improving agent framework that recursively extracts evidence from execution traces—tracking which symbolic edits survive, disappear, or interfere—to compile constrained alternative programs and enable recursive self-improvement for symbolic graphics reasoning.
